ev_0005.summary: Triangle ABC (C top ~(271.4,65), A (67,420), B (476.4,420)) with incircle centre O ~(271.8,302.2), r~118.4 px, consistent with the side length (~410 px, inradius = s/(2*sqrt3) ~118.4). The circle is tangent to AB at the bottom point T ~(272,420), which is the midpoint region between labels M (x~214, left) and N (x~331, right) on AB. Three solid segments pass through O: the vertical through O (seg_06, (272,179) to (272,425), bottom overshoot 5 px snapped to 420) and two +/-30 degree chords (seg_04 (164.3,240)-(378.7,364); seg_05 (165.4,364)-(378.6,240)). detect_right_angle_marker found NO verified square mark at the vertical/AB junction (perpendicular edges present but no square ink), so the right angle is geometrically perpendicular but unverified as a drawn mark. circle_02 (center (271.75,218), r 78, partial) is rejected as an artifact of the chords/vertical, not a second circle.

params.instruction: Reconcile the evidence into a geometry state for a TikZ reconstruction. Figure (547x487 px, origin top-left, y down): equilateral-looking triangle with vertices C top ~(272,65), A bottom-left ~(67,420), B bottom-right ~(476,420) (labels verified by vision: C, A, B). A full circle (circle_01 center ~(271.8,302.2), r~118.4 px) is detected, but the visible figure appears to be a circle of centre O ~(271.8,302) — NOTE: detect_circles also returned circle_02 center ~(271.8,218), r~78 px, partial (ink coverage 0.63); this is likely the incircle-like arc artifact of the lines and should be verified against the image: the figure shows a circle inscribed in the triangle, tangent to AB at the bottom point ~(272,420) and tangent to sides CA and CB. Reconcile: the circle inscribed in triangle ABC with centre O (label O, visually at ~(272,302)) and radius about 118 px. Three solid segments pass through O: the vertical segment from ~(272,179) to ~(272,425) and two segments at ±30 degrees from horizontal (line_04 from (164,240) to (379,364), line_05 from (165,364) to (379,240)). Labels verified visually: C, A, B, O, M (left of bottom tangent point, ~x=212, y=440) and N (right of it, ~x=330, y=440). Treat M and N as labels for the bottom tangent point region on AB, both attached to AB near x~272. Also report whether the vertical line meets AB at a right angle and whether detect_right_angle_marker verifies it (run it if you can). Output objects: triangle ABC, circle O (incircle), segments O-to-tangent points, labels with positions, and any conflicts. Do not fabricate coordinates; use the CV values above.
